messages.subject: ConditionalPanel doesn't work
parts:
Hi all,
Please help me because i don't understand why "conditionalPanel" no displays anything

#UI.R
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel("InfoSaniR Moyen-Ogoouée"),
         sidebarPanel( wellPanel(
         dateInput("date", h4("Année"),format = "yyyy"),
         tags$hr(),
        selectInput(inputId="Them", label=h4("Themes"),
              choices=list('Pathologies prioritaires','Rapport annuel')) 
    )),

  mainPanel(
      conditionalPanel(condition="input.Them=='Pathologies prioritaires'",
                  tabsetPanel(tabPanel(h5("Diagrammes"), plotOutput("plot")),
                  tabPanel(h5("Courbes de tendances"), verbatimTextOutput("summary")),
                  tabPanel(h5("Statistiques"), verbatimTextOutput("summary"))))
       
        )
))

Thanks all

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ConditionalPanel doesn't work
parts:
The problem is that you have two outputs named "summary", it's causing
Shiny to throw an error as it loads (you can see it in your browser's
JavaScript console). If you change one of the outputs I think you'll
find that the conditional panel will start working.
